auth.signInSubtitle: Passengers, taxi companies and administrators sign in here.
auth.displayNameHint: Shown to passengers in search results

validation.phoneTaken: This phone number is already in use.
validation.emailTaken: This email address is already in use.
validation.mustBeFuture: Must be a date in the future
validation.invalidRange: The end time must be after the start time

errors.unreachable: Could not reach the server. Is the backend running on port 8080?
errors.forbidden: You do not have permission to do that.
errors.pageFailed: This page could not be displayed

booking.title: Book a taxi
booking.subtitle: Pick your start and destination, then choose a taxi company.
booking.searchHint: Search for an address, or use your current location.
booking.runSearch: Run a search to see who is available.
booking.youChoose: You choose the company. They assign one of their drivers.
booking.noneAvailableHint: No company has an online driver near your pickup point. Try again shortly.
booking.activeRideTitle: You already have a ride in progress

ride.noActiveHint: Book a taxi and it will show up here with live status.
ride.cancelConfirm: Cancel this ride? The company will be notified.
ride.waitingTitle: Waiting for the company to respond
ride.waitingHint: If they do not answer in time, the request returns to searching and you can pick another company.
ride.noResponseTitle: The company did not respond in time
ride.noRidesHint: Your completed rides will appear here.

partner.ridesSubtitle: Accept a request, assign a driver, and drive it to completion.
partner.noRidesHint: Requests from passengers who chose your company appear here.
partner.noRideSelectedHint: Pick a ride from the list to act on it.
partner.declineConfirm: Decline this ride? The passenger can then choose another company.
partner.noDriverAvailableHint: A driver must be active, online and hold an active vehicle assignment before you can accept.
partner.taximeterHint: The real amount the passenger pays the driver
partner.rideFinished: This ride is finished ({{status}}). No further action is possible.
partner.driversSubtitle: Going online shares this device's location so passengers can find the driver. Open this page on the driver's phone.
partner.deactivateConfirm: Deactivate {{name}}? They will stop appearing in passenger search.
partner.noDriversHint: Add a driver, give them a vehicle, then put them online.
partner.oneDriverOnline: One driver is online from this device.
partner.manyDriversOnline: {{count}} drivers are online from this device.
partner.positionInterval: Position is sent about every 25 seconds while the tab stays open.
partner.locationRequired: Location is required to go online
partner.devToolNotice: Development tool. In production a driver's position comes from their device GPS.
partner.vehiclesSubtitle: The cars your drivers can be assigned to.
partner.noVehiclesHint: Add a vehicle to get started.
partner.assignmentsSubtitle: A driver needs an active vehicle before they can go online.
partner.noAssignmentsHint: Pair a driver with a vehicle to put them on the road.
partner.documentsSubtitle: Upload your company paperwork, then submit for verification.
partner.underReviewHint: An administrator is reviewing your documents. You cannot change them right now.
partner.settingsSubtitle: Company details and how you take bookings.
partner.bookingsHint: Only approved and active companies appear in search.
partner.acceptingBookingsHint: Turn off to disappear from passenger search
partner.paymentMethodsHint: At least one is required. Passengers pay the driver directly; KALO does not process payments.
partner.requiredBeforeSubmit: Required before you can submit for verification
partner.licenceExpiryHint: This is the company's taxi licence, separate from the expiry on the uploaded document.

availability.title: Availability
availability.subtitle: Where you operate and when you accept bookings. Both are checked when a passenger searches.
availability.serviceAreaHint: Pickups outside this radius are not offered to you.
availability.setCentre: Click the map to set the centre of your service area.
availability.operatingHoursHint: When your company accepts bookings. This is separate from whether a driver is online.
availability.openAllDayHint: Set the same time for both to stay open all day.
availability.notApprovedYet: These settings become available once your company is approved.

admin.verificationSubtitle: Companies waiting for review. Approving one activates it immediately.
admin.nothingToReviewHint: Companies appear here once they submit for verification.
admin.approveConfirm: Approve {{name}}? It will immediately become active and appear in passenger search.
admin.rejectReasonPlaceholder: What needs to be fixed before resubmitting?
admin.rejectHint: The partner keeps access so they can fix the problem and submit again.
admin.noCompanySelectedHint: Pick one from the queue to see its documents.
admin.companiesSubtitle: Suspending a company removes it from search and blocks new rides. History is kept.
admin.suspendConfirm: Suspend {{name}}? It will disappear from passenger search and cannot accept new rides.
admin.suspensionNote: Suspension applies only to approved companies. A company still in onboarding is approved or rejected from the Verification page.
admin.usersSubtitle: Suspended users cannot sign in, and existing tokens stop working.
admin.suspendUserConfirm: Suspend {{name}}? They will be signed out and cannot sign in again.
admin.noRideSelectedHint: Pick a ride to see its detail.
admin.noDocuments: No documents. Approval requires at least one pending document.

profile.title: Profile
profile.subtitle: Your account details.
profile.phoneReadOnly: Your phone is your username and cannot be changed here.
profile.verificationNotice: Phone verification is not part of the MVP yet, so this stays unverified.

guest.headline: See which taxi companies are near you
guest.intro: KALO is a marketplace, not a taxi operator. You pick the company, they assign one of their drivers, and you pay the driver directly — the final price is the real taximeter amount.
guest.pickLocationHint: Click anywhere on the map to check that spot.
guest.nothingHereHint: No company has an online driver near this point. Try another spot or check again shortly.
guest.resultsHint: Results show each company's nearest available driver.
guest.step1Body: Tell KALO where you are and where you are going.
guest.step2Body: You see one offer per company, with its rating and distance.
guest.step3Body: The company sends one of its own drivers. You pay the driver directly.
